title: My Savior's Love
alsoKnownAs: I Stand Amazed in the Presence
description: My Savior's Love in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 5 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Charles Hutchinson Gabriel, first published in 1905. The tune, MY SAVIOR, is by Charles Hutchinson Gabriel (1905). This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: I stand a-mazed in the pres-ence Of Je-sus the Naz-a-rene, And won-der how He could love me, A sin-ner, con-demn'd, un-clean. How mar-vel-ous! how won-der-ful! And my song shall ev-er be: How mar-vel-ous! how won-der-ful! Is my_ Sav-ior's love for me!

lines: I stand amazed in the presence
Of Jesus the Nazarene,
And wonder how He could love me,
A sinner, condemn'd, unclean.

verses.label: Refrain
lines: How marvelous!
how wonderful!
And my song shall ever be:
How marvelous!
how wonderful!
Is my Savior's love for me!
For me it was in the garden
He pray'd "Not my will, but Thine;"
He had no tears for His own griefs,
But sweat drops of blood for mine.
In pity angels beheld Him,
And came from the world of light
To comfort Him in the sorrows,
He bore for my soul that night.
When with the ransomed in glory
His face I at last shall see,
'Twill be my joy thro' the ages,
To sing of His love for me.
